Definition: Alush, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Once in each verse, a camp in the wilderness: they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush, and they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink. The name is a stopping place on the way to Sinai, and the stopping is all the Bible says of it.
TheologicalSignificance: Two verses name the camp and nothing more, and the spareness is the point: the way out of Egypt was measured camp by camp, and the next camp had no water at all.
